✔ Multiplayer in All Locations – Launch fireworks together in any scenic spot.
✔ Synced Fireworks & Music – Watch the same dazzling show in perfect harmony.
✔ Shared Playlists – Play the same custom songs if everyone owns them—no more silent skies!

Note: All players must own the same custom tracks for shared playback.

Update now and celebrate together! 🚀

notes.title: EA version has been updated to v0.20
notes.content:
Once again, everyone has waited long! Thank you all for your support! Please let me know any ideas you have!
This, the first larger update of 2023, includes the following.
[h1]1. LOGO update[/h1]
[b]The MAFShow logo has been added with more dynamic elements and completely refurbished. [/b]
The logo is now more dynamic in the main interface and splash screen interface.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928311/42f9c64f17adadaddbae2a991ed72e63e75202d1.png[/img]

[h1]2. Interaction optimization[/h1]
Updated almost all the regular buttons with [b]neon elements[/b] for a clearer and more beautiful display.
The distance the firework stick points is now more accurate and will correctly display the interaction interface touched.

[h1]3. New fireworks and configurations[/h1]
Added 6 new types of regular fireworks.
3 new super fireworks have been added.
Now there are 45 types of fireworks, all of which can be used at will in the fireworks show editor.
Added 2 new color configurations.
Added 21 new fireworks configurations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928311/80d06411ee78cf7845a49a60bb3afaf56f31e01c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928311/15ccb810bbbdc44acfeb6ffe23d5e802542b5215.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928311/6d61a924d91db903fe8ecb3ee176ccfc0da55ace.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928311/1560f0a772f21f4986aa60317f0dd2c49098cb55.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928311/bf1ea0ca27789308356c8e23e2af3da7773d43fb.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928311/e3858c0ad17835733cbcd5521e97f35d2ce44bc9.gif[/img]

[h1]4. lighting[/h1]
Upgraded to [b]lighting system 2.0[/b], of the original lights on the basis of the additional new rhythm laser and light, enjoy the dance of laser and searchlight light!

[h1]5. New generation mode[/h1]
A new Japanese fireworks display mode has been added.
After selecting the music, the mode selection will appear, at this time select the Japanese mode.
In Japan mode, the duration of the fireworks is shorter, the display matches more abundantly, and the fireworks display is more coherent and ambient!

[h1]6. Optimization of viewing locations[/h1]
[b]New viewing locations have been added to Marina Park[/b] to enjoy the gorgeous fireworks under the Ferris wheel.
[b]Added a new location for viewing the cruise ships at sea[/b] to enjoy the fireworks show in the harbor as the ships move.
Optimized other viewing locations for lighting fireworks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928311/dc2a5b76736e8a0068284a8880d57b8b62c5ef14.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928311/8a3b2db88b3355d9c1cd857226a1a4a89a3df53a.png[/img]

[h1]7. urban optimization[/h1]
Optimized the performance of the park in the coastal area, adding rocks, flowers, lighting atmosphere, fences, etc.
Optimized the Ferris wheel view, now the lights of the Ferris wheel will change slowly with time.
In addition to the default sky, added two kinds of skies to choose from, evening and cloudy, you can use random sky or choose the right one by yourself.

[h1]8. music sound effects[/h1]
Added a new built-in music, come and enjoy.
Added a new city sound effect, enabled by default, you can also choose the original sound effect in the settings to use.

[h1]9. UI optimization[/h1]
Music list scroll bar is thickened, easy to click.

[h1]10. Performance improvements[/h1]
Optimized the performance of some fireworks, up to 5 times better.

[h1]11. Issue fixes[/h1]
Fixed the issue that the image setting menu button may not work when pressed.
Fixed the issue that the music settings menu button may not work when pressed.
Fixed the problem that the game setting menu button may not work when pressed.
Fixed the performance problem of some fireworks in the editor.
Fixed the problem that some firework particles are not rotated.
Fixed the problem of incoherent display of some fireworks.
Fixed the problem that some super fireworks trajectories are not interrupted correctly.
Fixed the problem that the preview performance of some fireworks in the editor is different from the official fireworks.
Fixed the problem that some official fireworks sometimes have too much smoke when bursting and cause lag.
Fixed the terrain problem in the villa area.
Fixed the problem that the roof viewing position would be blocked by the sunshade.
Fixed the problem that some settings did not take effect

[h1]12. Other[/h1]
Adopted a new game icon and loading map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928311/7123bc3d0413fb3f5307e3b914617436efd2c274.png[/img]

Subsequent versions [b]will add online play and mod support and other content[/b] as soon as possible, so stay tuned.

If you have any questions, please feel free to ask them through the Discord channel, community or email.

We hope you enjoy the Music & Fireworks Show, and good luck!

notes.title: EA version has been updated to v0.10.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it's been two weeks since my last update, and I apologize for the delay and thank you for your support! Please let me know any thoughts you may have!
This update has the following new features.
[h2]1. Firework show editor[/h2]
Show off your fireworks show directing talents in the exclusive studio in the Magnificent Bay City landmark building right now!
Whether it's the oversized skylights and floor-to-ceiling windows, the modern decor or the rich fireworks panel will help you edit your fireworks show better.
Just select the files you have already enjoyed and place the fireworks cards you want to see on the sandbox according to the progress to finish editing easily.
Choose to play the fireworks show file in the main interface and you can enjoy the edited fireworks show!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928311/b7744f46a02b537badfec31a182841704fe955ca.gif[/img]
[b]The editor needs to have seen at least one live generated fireworks show before it can be used, and you can edit the files of the fireworks show you have already seen. [/b]

[h2]2. List viewing[/h2]
Now you can switch between enjoying one piece of music and enjoying a list of music.
Choose how you want to generate the fireworks show during each song: either with a fireworks show file or in real time.
Unlimited list expansion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928311/ac36e5c0c54aea94aecf3c99ea91679391ac4582.gif[/img]

[h2]3. super fireworks[/h2]
New mechanic - Super Fireworks, with an incredible roaming fireworks effect.
When viewed using the real-time generated fireworks mode, there is a chance that they will appear each time the music approaches its climax.

When selecting music, you can choose to use the fireworks archive file to play, or regenerate the fireworks show altogether.
The new fireworks show will be automatically stored as a fireworks archive file at the end of the show.
Playing from a fireworks archive will replay the last fireworks show played and improve playback performance.
Future updates will gradually support editing fireworks archives!

notes.title: EA version has been updated to v0.1.5
notes.content:
Hello everyone, fellow players! After a few days, this time we bring you MAFShow EA v0.1.5 update.

[b]1. More types of fireworks[/b]
Three new fireworks effects have been added, bringing the total number of effect types to nearly 20!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928311/8619b480ec385fde8da7c30abe2fd353299c5bd3.gif[/img]

[b]2. Random and more differentiated firework colors and effects[/b]
This update adjusts the random method of fireworks color and color sampling method, combined with the optimized fireworks combination sample combination random configuration algorithm, so that the whole fireworks show is full of changes.

[b]3. Fireworks box model optimization and new impact effects[/b]
Adjusted the style of the fireworks box and the feel of the strike, and added a new strike effect when striking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928311/a5aed7001f37075e3dd88a016f8ef9fbdaab644b.gif[/img]

[b]4. laser lights[/b]
Music fireworks of course need lights! This additional 2 groups of 4 laser lights, will automatically swing with the rhythm and change color, so that the performance effect to a higher level.
(If you do not want to see the lights, you can turn it off in the settings)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928311/c00597ccb891c107912fb1d4c4f7268743aa20a7.gif[/img]

[b]5. Other optimizations[/b]
Fixed 3 potential problems.
Adjusted the position of some buildings to reduce the obscuration of the fireworks show.

If you want to know more about the subsequent version update planning, or make your comments or suggestions, [b]feel free to visit the MAFShow Discord channel and let me know[/b] ːsteamhappyː!
Finally, thanks again for playing MAFShow, and good luck!
